method: Equal weight across the eight study-quality variables. Scores use the live audit after the strict-form insert. A Hard label is not treated as proof of 3-5x difficulty. Template families are not scored as independent coverage or as 5x items. No variable is scored from intention alone.

evidence.satForm: Strict validated SAT form exam 39: 98 questions, reading 27, english 27, math 44, module 2 easy 22, module 2 hard 22
evidence.actForm: Strict validated ACT form exam 40: 131 questions, English 50, Math 45, Reading 36, no science section, not adaptive
evidence.limitation: New items are original and algebraically or passage-fact checked, but most are template families distinguished by a setting, passage, or practice index. That keeps difficulty, graph realism, validation quality, and duplicate control below 95.
